description.value: BC Liquor Store (store #49) is a government-operated retail liquor outlet in Enderby, part of the province-wide BCLIQUOR network of 198 stores. It stocks wine, spirits, beer, coolers, and ciders across a broad selection. For touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan & Thompson corridor, it is a convenient stop to pick up beverages for the evening camp or the next stretch of road.
